objective: Complete bounded prime-field quotient algebras and genuine FGLM monomial-order conversion.

implementation.quotient_algebra: Enumerate the complete standard-monomial staircase; compute the multiplication operator of an arbitrary admitted quotient element, with row-major residue matrices whose columns are reduced products.
implementation.quotient_verifier: Bind the immutable accepted source receipt to every original coefficient, typed ring, prime and order. Independently require one, standardness, unique ordered entries and complete unblocked coordinate closure; check each matrix column by signed coefficient convolution without generator division or rank search.
implementation.fglm: Use source normal-form coordinates, a bounded deterministic target-order heap and incremental exact modular elimination. Only independent monomials extend the frontier. Dependencies generate monic target relations; no target-order Buchberger search, rational retry or point enumeration is used.
implementation.fglm_verifier: Reuse the complete independent prime-field Groebner verifier: both ideal inclusions, monicity, reducedness and all strict S-pair identities. Target receipt inputs name the accepted source basis, establishing ideal equality transitively with the original source receipt.
implementation.special_cases: Repeated-root and nilpotent directions are retained. The unit ideal has a zero-dimensional vector quotient; the explicit constant field has basis one. Different-order positive-dimensional requests refuse; same-order requests still admit their source and verify a complete target witness without staircase enumeration.
implementation.ownership: Immutable accepted source receipts are shared through Arc for multiplication. Accepted witnesses are copied under the verifier meter. A single complete_candidate helper is now crate-visible for FGLM certificate completion.
